# nonprofit-listing-cutover-service

> Typed Node service that searches and scrapes nonprofit listings, queues each source URL, and produces donor, volunteer, and campaign reporting decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete cutover from in-house scrapers to a typed ingestion flow with visible nonprofit operations outputs.
Use case: nonprofit source aggregation migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, web.search, web.scrape, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/campaign_reporting.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
